summary: POET Technologies Inc. filed a Form 6-K reporting a registered direct offering with MMCAP International Inc. SPC. The company agreed to sell 19,047,620 common shares and warrants for 19,047,620 additional shares at $21.00 per unit. The warrants have a $26.25 exercise price and three-year term. Net proceeds are ~$399.7 million. The offering closes on May 18, 2026, and is made under an existing F-3 shelf registration. Bennett Jones LLP (Canadian counsel) and Katten Muchin Rosenman LLP (U.S. counsel) provided legal opinions. No placement agent is involved. This is a routine capital-raising transaction, not a special situation, as it involves a common stock and warrant issuance under an effective shelf registration without strategic implications like a tender offer, going-private, or restructuring.
